title: No-change drift control: check the absent observation in memory, not only in the persisted snapshot
outcome: no_change_between_named_root_turns_sends_no_observation (src/tests/engram_drift_reaches_store.rs) checks 'no observation is prepared for the next turn, sent or not' against the SQLite snapshot (load_state). A pending persist write would let that pass even if an intent existed; the wire check is the one that discriminates. Read claimed.state.inner.engram_source_sightings under the lock instead, or narrow the message.
acceptance: The control's negative is checked against the in-memory source sightings under the state lock (or its message is narrowed to what the snapshot proves); the focused test passes.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
